mission_07: Fantastic! You have learned the indicator variable approach, a powerful technique for handling Missing Not at Random (MNAR) data. By creating binary flags that mark which values were imputed, you preserve the information contained in the missingness pattern itself. This is crucial when the reason for missing data is systematically related to the variable value or the target. SimpleImputer with add_indicator=True automates this process, appending indicator columns to your imputed data. This approach is widely used in healthcare analytics, survey analysis, and financial modeling where non-response is often systematic rather than random. By including both imputed values and missingness indicators, your models can leverage the full information content of your dataset.
